entities.summary: Grigoriy Demidovtsev is the pen name of Grigoriy Anatolyevich Petrov, a Russian fiction writer and a playwright. Since 2001 he publishes Biznes Segodnya. In 2014 he was awarded the A. K. Tolstoy Literary Prize.
